selection: First complete February Monday-Friday; GCJ6 throughout; chosen before measurements
clock: Causal canonical complete-publication available_ns; 1-second observations London open through liquidation deadline
bollinger: Existing native developing 19 completed closes + current midpoint; SMA20 +/- 2 sample SD (ddof=1); M1/M3/M6/M9
vwap: Sum(price_T * quantity_T)/sum(quantity_T); +/-2 sqrt(sum(quantity_T*(price_T-VWAP)^2)/sum(quantity_T)); population price dispersion, not standard error
aligned_window: Current native bucket opening minus 19 native periods, inclusive, through current observation inclusive; same temporal support as 19 completed bars + current developing bar
controls: VWMA native midpoint closes weighted by each bar T volume
VWAP of publication midpoint at each T, same volumes/times
variance_control: Bollinger sample SD is sqrt(20/19) times its population SD; width comparisons retain and disclose this 2.60 percent factor
support: No cross-contract stitching; invalid BBO, epoch changes or >60s publication gaps reset; rolling windows require full supported interval; native comparison uses BB warmup too
trend: 60-second central-line displacement; sign disagreement only when both absolute displacements exceed one GC tick ($0.10); report sample count
scale_match: Calendar match is primary. Secondary line-RMSE fit over factors 0.5/0.75/1/1.25/1.5/2 on Feb2-3 only, compare Feb4-6 on identical common candidate support. Descriptive geometry calibration, no profit fit.
causality: All T in completed publications, including unknown aggressor side; F and C excluded. Future source rows never enter an observation.
scope: One-week descriptive line/band comparison. No fitted trading model, no execution or profitability claim. Sampled paths are not a full quote-clock crossing bank.
